# Icon Picker

> Searchable icon grid and color swatches using an app-supplied icon catalog.

Status: beta.

This file matches the installed `icon-picker` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version.

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/icon-picker.json
```

With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/icon-picker.md`.

- `@/components/control-ui/knob-contracts/icon-picker-knobs`: `iconPickerKnobs`, types `IconPickerKnobStyle`
- `@/components/control-ui/ui/icon-picker`: `IconPicker`, `IconPickerSearch`, `IconPickerContent`, `IconPickerColors`, types `IconPickerItem`, `IconPickerColor`, `IconPickerProps`, `IconPickerSearchProps`, `IconPickerContentProps`, `IconPickerColorsProps`

## Composition

### Icon grid

The app supplies icons, search keywords, and color choices. IconPickerColors controls a separate color value; pass it to IconPicker as iconColor to tint the grid.

```tsx
<IconPicker>
  <IconPickerSearch />
  <IconPickerColors />
  <IconPickerContent />
</IconPicker>
```

## Usage

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { IconPicker, IconPickerColors, IconPickerContent, IconPickerSearch } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/icon-picker";
import { pickerColors, pickerIcons } from "./picker-data";

export function PrimitiveIconPickerExample() {
  const [selectedIcon, setSelectedIcon] = useState("folder");
  const [colorValue, setColorValue] = useState("default");
  const color = pickerColors.find((swatch) => swatch.value === colorValue);
  if (!color) throw new Error(`Unknown icon color: ${colorValue}`);

  return (
    <IconPicker items={pickerIcons} value={selectedIcon} onValueChange={setSelectedIcon} iconColor={color.color}>
      <IconPickerSearch />
      <IconPickerColors colors={pickerColors} value={colorValue} onValueChange={setColorValue} />
      <IconPickerContent />
    </IconPicker>
  );
}
```
